Sudowoodo''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 303rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the first chapter of the {{MangaArc|Emerald}}. It is subtitled '''The Shining Frontier''' (Japanese: '''まばゆきフロンティア''' ''Dazzling Frontier'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Dazzling Frontier''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} In an unspecified location, [[Brandon]] finds the three [[Legendary Pokémon]]; {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}}. He throws three {{i|Poké Ball}}s, which successfully capture the three titans with ease. Brandon calls his boss, [[Scott]], to report to him his successful mission. Brandon expresses surprise that his boss was able to retrieve and fix the [[Sealed Chamber|stone tablet]], which had broken into pieces after the events of the battle between {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}. Scott congratulates Brandon, and reveals that [[Anabel]] has captured {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou}} in [[Johto]] and plans on using it in her [[battle facility]]. Scott hangs up the call to look at how the construction is going. As he gushes over how his dream of a {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} is nearing completion, he gets another call on his [[Pokégear]]. Scott answers the call, which turns out to be from {{adv|Professor Oak}}. Two months later, a {{p|Latios|blue-colored Pokémon}} and a {{p|Latias|red-colored Pokémon}} drop someone off at the Battle Frontier. Meanwhile, an excited [[Todd Snap|reporter]] waits for the Battle Frontier's opening ceremony. As he waits, he decides to dump the remaining [[Fresh Water]] he had in his bottle, due to getting full from drinking it, on a tree. Suddenly, something falls from the sky and lands in a bush. The reporter picks it up, and finds out that it's a {{DL|Trainer Card (game)|Frontier Pass}} that belongs to someone named {{adv|Emerald}}. A person with a blond croissant-shaped hairstyle also falls from the sky and takes the Frontier Pass, as it belongs to him. As Emerald attempts to take it, he falls down, revealing that he wears platform shoes to make himself taller. The reporter decides to interview Emerald and begins asking him questions. Before Emerald can answer, the tree that the reporter watered grabs him, revealing itself to be a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Emerald|Sudowoodo}}. The reporter asks Emerald for help, but the boy states that he doesn't have any Pokémon with him. The reporter gets confused, as he thought that Emerald is a Pokémon lover, which is why he came to the Battle Frontier. Suddenly, Emerald pulls out a gun and corrects the reporter by stating that he doesn't like Pokémon, and likes Pokémon battles. Emerald then begins firing on the two rapidly. ==Major events== * A few months have passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. ** Two months before the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}'s opening, [[Brandon]] catches {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}}. ** Two months before the Battle Frontier's opening, [[Anabel]] is revealed to have captured {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou}}. * [[Scott]] gets a mysterious call from {{adv|Professor Oak}}. * [[Todd Snap]] arrives at the Battle Frontier. * {{adv|Emerald}} arrives at the Battle Frontier. * A wild {{TP|Emerald|Sudowoodo}} attacks Todd. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Brandon]] * {{adv|Emerald}} * [[Todd Snap]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Latias}} ({{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias|Adventures}}) * {{p|Latios}} ({{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios|Adventures}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Emerald}} * [[Brandon]] * [[Todd Snap]] * [[Scott]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Regirock}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Brandon's]]; new) * {{p|Regice}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Brandon's]]; new) * {{p|Registeel}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Brandon's]]; new) * {{p|Latias}} ({{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias|Adventures}}) * {{p|Latios}} ({{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios|Adventures}}) * {{p|Sudowoodo}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Emerald}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Emerald}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 胡說樹|VS Sudowoodo}} (Taiwan)
